item.title: My First Blog
item.description: Charting My Technical Journey: Why Public Writing Matters Hello and welcome! As a third-semester electronics and computer engineering student, I am excited to embark on a new chapter: sharing my technical journey with a focus on software—especially cybersecurity, machine learning, and artificial intelligence. These rapidly evolving fields inspire curiosity and challenge me to grow every day. 📘 The Power of Documenting What You Learn The idea for this site grew from insightful conversations with my seniors, teacher, and uncle—experienced voices who helped me see that writing about what I learn is a powerful tool for understanding and growth.
